aboutMe.title: Hakkımda
aboutMe.intro: Hey there, I'm Onur! Write some information about yourself that is IT related. Why are you passionate about coding? What is your source of inspiration for improving your programming skills?
aboutMe.connect: Let's connect and create something amazing together!
aboutMe.location: Where are you located? Are you open to different ways of working, such as working remotely or even relocating?
aboutMe.mindset: Show that you are open-minded. Are you enthusiastic about learning new technologies and continually improving your skills?
aboutMe.problemSolving: A brief description of your problem-solving approach. Do you learn from each challenge as you search for the most efficient or elegant solution? You can include some keywords like: analytical thinking, creativity, persistence and collaboration.

skills.title: Yetenekler
skills.description: Highlight your experience of working on different projects using different front-end technologies (such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, etc.) and emphasise your openness to learning and adapting to new technologies. Mention the importance of continuing education to keep up with the rapid changes in web development.
skills.questionText: Reveal enthusiasm for learning new technologies and frameworks.

portfolio.title: Portfolyo
portfolio.intro: Burada çalışmalarımdan bir seçki bulabilirsin – becerilerimi iş başında görmek için projelerle etkileşime geç.

projects.polloLoco: Nesne yönelimli programlamaya dayalı zıpla, koş ve fırlat oyunu. Çılgın tavuğa karşı savaşmak için Pepe'nin madeni para ve tabasco sosu bulmasına yardım et.
projects.join: Kanban sisteminden ilham alan görev yöneticisi. Görevleri sürükle-bırak ile oluştur ve düzenle, kullanıcı ve kategori ata.
projects.simpleCrm: CRUD işlevleriyle çalışan çok basit bir müşteri ilişkileri yönetim sistemi.
projects.pokedex: PokéAPI tabanlı, Pokémon bilgilerini sunan ve kataloglayan basit bir kütüphane.
